source: silver tables built from the real Volve delivery
warning: These are parameters describing the shape of real data. Data generated from them is FIXTURE and must never be presented as measurements of the Volve field - SPEC.md section 10.

anomaly_counts_observed.basis: counted in silver_production_daily: calendar gaps inside a wellbore's span, repeated _row_hash, runs of 3+ identical non-zero volumes, day-over-day changes beyond 5 sigma. Clock skew is 0 because production carries a date, not a timestamp, so the class cannot occur

anomaly_rate_clock_skew.basis: measured 0 occurrences in 14859 rows of real production, so there is no rate to calibrate. The generator can still inject this class at --dirt-level 2, where the rate is a deliberate test input rather than a claim about the field

anomaly_rate_dropout.basis: missing calendar days as a fraction of observed production days

anomaly_rate_duplicate.basis: measured 0 occurrences in 14859 rows of real production, so there is no rate to calibrate. The generator can still inject this class at --dirt-level 2, where the rate is a deliberate test input rather than a claim about the field

anomaly_rate_frozen.basis: measured 0 occurrences in 14859 rows of real production, so there is no rate to calibrate. The generator can still inject this class at --dirt-level 2, where the rate is a deliberate test input rather than a claim about the field

anomaly_rate_spike.basis: measured 0 occurrences in 14859 rows of real production, so there is no rate to calibrate. The generator can still inject this class at --dirt-level 2, where the rate is a deliberate test input rather than a claim about the field

decline_shape_by_wellbore.basis: each producing year's mean oil as a fraction of the wellbore's best year

identity_unresolved_count.basis: identities in silver with no wellbore_uid

identity_variants_per_wellbore.basis: distinct written identities divided by distinct resolved wellbores

las_sentinel_sample_share.basis: fraction of log samples whose value equalled the declared sentinel

las_sentinel_spellings.basis: every distinct NULL sentinel declared in a LAS ~WELL section, by file count

on_stream_hours_distribution.basis: share of production days that are full, partial, shut in, or unreported

production_rate_by_wellbore.basis: mean, stddev and peak daily oil per producing wellbore

rig_state_distribution.basis: NOT MEASURED. This delivery contains no WITSML log curves - mnemonicList appears in zero of 10,773 files - so no channel range or rig-state distribution could be computed. These are plausible drilling ranges used to generate load-test volume, and are not a claim about Volve

shutdown_event_count.basis: runs of consecutive zero-uptime days, counted as one shutdown each

telemetry_channels.basis: NOT MEASURED. This delivery contains no WITSML log curves - mnemonicList appears in zero of 10,773 files - so no channel range or rig-state distribution could be computed. These are plausible drilling ranges used to generate load-test volume, and are not a claim about Volve

telemetry_sample_interval_seconds.basis: NOT MEASURED. This delivery contains no WITSML log curves - mnemonicList appears in zero of 10,773 files - so no channel range or rig-state distribution could be computed. These are plausible drilling ranges used to generate load-test volume, and are not a claim about Volve. 5 s is a common WITSML surface-log rate

water_cut_by_wellbore_year.basis: mean daily water cut per wellbore per year

water_cut_rise_per_year.basis: mean annual increase in water cut across producing wellbores
